user.title: ALLPOWERS power station
user.description: Pick a station seen by Home Assistant's Bluetooth. Close the ALLPOWERS app first: the station accepts only one connection.

bluetooth_confirm.title: ALLPOWERS power station
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address})? Close the ALLPOWERS app first: the station accepts only one Bluetooth connection, and while Home Assistant is connected the app cannot connect.

abort.no_devices_found: No ALLPOWERS station found. Turn its Bluetooth on, close the ALLPOWERS app and try again.

data_description.update_interval: The station sends data about twice a second. Entities are updated at most this often, to keep the recorder database small. Connection changes are shown immediately.
